description: Patch schema for local Qwen-Image-2512 text-to-image generation through ComfyUI-GGUF.

unmapped_ui_parameters.image: Image input is handled by the companion qwen_image_2512_i2i_gguf workflow when ModelInputs.mode is img2img.
unmapped_ui_parameters.strength: Image strength is mapped to KSampler denoise only in the companion img2img workflow.
unmapped_ui_parameters.frames: The existing image-plugin frame control is preserved by the surrounding UI but this workflow emits one PNG per generate call.
unmapped_ui_parameters.custom_loras: The workflow applies the committed Lightning adapter. Dynamic project LoRA injection remains a follow-up because Comfy API workflows require concrete local LoRA filenames.

output.contract: Return one readable PNG image matching the mapped requested dimensions.
